summary: Hiker separated from office-retreat group on Mount Shavano became disoriented in freezing rain and high winds, fell repeatedly, and was found below Esprit Point above the North Fork drainage; extracted and transported to hospital
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR South + SAR North, El Paso County SAR, Fremont SAR, Western Mountain Rescue Team, Park County SAR, Teller County SAR, Arapahoe Rescue Patrol, Cañon Helitack; Chaffee County SAR South plus nine assisting teams/agencies including DFPC Canon Helitack
notes: approx Friday date; multi-agency search; helicopter search unsuccessful overnight; approx; outing was Friday Aug 23; hiker spent night out and was found/recovered Aug 24; Merged 2 reports (parts: news-2024-2026, sarlogs); date per SAR log (outing date); news report listed 2024-08-24. Merge 2026-09-11: NPR confirms hike was Friday 2024-08-23 (15-person office-retreat group, man in his 50s, insurance industry); overdue call 9 p.m. Friday; found Saturday 2024-08-24 morning in a gully above the North Fork drainage below Espirit Point after regaining cell signal and calling 911; rope-system extraction, brief hospitalization. Chaffee County SAR South led; CCSAR-North + El Paso, Fremont, Park, Teller SAR + Western Mountain Rescue + Arapahoe Rescue Patrol + Canon Helitack assisted. Merge 2026-09-14 (run 525): CSAR Impact Story 'Corporate retreat gone wrong on Shavano' URL appended (opened this run — same incident: 15-person corporate-retreat group, solo summit push, 9 p.m. Friday 911 call to Chaffee County SAR South, ~100 responders from 10 backcountry SAR teams; story says found by drone team at midday vs SAR-log Saturday-morning 911-call find — operator detail discrepancy noted).
